title: The Door Book
blurb: Source-gen writes the switch; the brick only stores numbers.

chapters.title: Compile vs play
chapters.text: The brick only stores numbers. Someone has to write a book that says what number forty two means. That book is generated when your project compiles, onto your partial Context type.
chapters.deep: BovineLabs.ContextGenerator skips generating inside BovineLabs.Grove, Grove.Authoring, and Grove.Editor assemblies. Your game assembly is where the partial Context is completed. Referenced public attributed methods from Grove still appear as switch cases.

chapters.title: What it hunts
chapters.text: It finds your partial struct that implements I Context. It finds static methods with Execute Node or Data Node attributes. It also peeks into Grove for public built-in toys like Composite.
chapters.deep: Context must be a partial unmanaged struct implementing IContext of Self and exposing GroveStates. Node methods must be static, not in generic outer types, with context by ref. Generic T where T is IContext of T matches every context. Concrete MyContext matches only that one.

chapters.title: What it writes
chapters.text: Create Generated, Update Generated, and Set Chunk Generated wire your component bags. Then big switches: Execution Generated and Data Generated. Debug doors appear only when instrumentation is on.
chapters.deep: Recognized fields include ComponentContainer, BufferContainer, EnableableContainer, SharedComponentContainer, ComponentLookup, BufferLookup, EntityStorageInfoLookup. Emit also covers debug methods under UNITY_INCLUDE_INSTRUMENTATION.

chapters.title: Play time
chapters.text: Play never invents methods. Header Type selects a case. That case calls your static method with payload rehydrated from bytes after the header. Unknown Type becomes a no-op or default value.
chapters.deep: ExecutionHeader.Execute calls ExecutionGenerated. DataHeader.Calculate special-cases Default, Constant, Variable, VariableSet, then DataGenerated. Payload is recovered with pointer arithmetic after the header size.
